source_fields: ap_fines evaluated on original AP geometry
AH old deposited classes, debited first by CE removal
model: Authored static stratigraphy inside the already-retained current terrain. Spatially varying original fine stock is partitioned into an effective surface cap using existing historical fine-area coverage. Pre-existing clasts descend relative to that cap; recent finite deposited representatives keep their source roles. No new mass, terrain elevation, transport, rainfall or measured chronology.
optical_interpretation: Original cap coverage is bounded ap_fines times current CE gate and finite-thickness saturation. It joins the existing event fine closure by bounded union; no independent BW overcoat is restored.
limits: Mean-column support depth and area-fraction optics are authored approximations, not resolved grain packing or measured stratigraphy.
Original intrinsic embedding remains; this is a static support interpretation rather than an inferred weathering age.
Old original/matrix and event populations are separated on the same CE vertex basis before interpolating.
Roundoff corrections are reported explicitly; strict20nm per-class tolerance only covers float32 stock serialization.
